title: Hisaab shop file (import), version 2.0.1.0
description: The JSON pasted into #import-box and loaded with #import-go, checked by validateImport() in src/lib/validate.ts. The check is all or nothing: the first row that fails stops the import with a message naming the row (for example "Entry 3: unknown phone 9876543210. Nothing was changed.") and the ledger stays exactly as it was. A file that passes replaces the whole ledger (shop name, customers, entries); the shop's UPI id set in Settings is kept; there is no Undo. Text that is not JSON gives "That is not valid JSON. Nothing was changed.". Unknown properties are ignored. Only JSON is read: 2.0.1.0 has no CSV import.

shop.description: Shop name, trimmed. Missing, empty or not a string: "Shop" is used.

customers.description: Customers, in the order to keep. May be empty.

name.description: Required, trimmed. Error: "Customer N: name is required."

phone.description: Exactly 10 digits, as a string (trimmed) or as a whole number. Error: "Customer N: phone must be 10 digits." A phone used twice: "Duplicate phone P."

entries.description: Optional. Missing or null is read as no entries. The order of the file is kept: of two entries with the same date the later row is the newer one.

phone.description: The phone of a customer in this file. Errors: "Entry N: phone must be 10 digits.", "Entry N: unknown phone P."

type.description: Error: "Entry N: type must be credit or payment."

amount.description: A whole number above 0, or a string of digits ("500" is read as 500). A fraction is refused. Error: "Entry N: amount must be a positive whole number."

date.description: Error: "Entry N: date must be YYYY-MM-DD."

note.description: Optional; anything that is not a string becomes "".

shot.description: Optional. Kept only when it starts with data:image/ and has at most 400,000 characters; otherwise dropped without an error.
